blocks.html: “The Voice Kids” alumni Edray Teodoro, Kyle Echarri, Noel Comia Jr. and LA Voice Singing Contest winner Mika Gorospe will perform live at Forum Robinsons on June 24 at 4pm. Catch the next generation of talented young singers as they perform their hits on stage at the fountain area. Also, fans of Noel Comia Jr. are in for a treat as the young singer launches his newest music video titled “The Show”. Former Team Sarah member Kyle Echarri will have a more meaningful day as he launches his newest music video titled “Our Moment” and at the same time celebrate his birthday together with his supportive fans. At the end of the program, all of the fans who bought the albums of their favorite singers at the event area courtesy of Astroplus will get a chance to get their autographs during the autograph signing session.
